text:
Claire H: Hey team, I paid for last-week's booth catering on my personal card. Vendor gave a single POS receipt for $1,240 — no VAT number and no itemized lines. Need to file for reimbursement and split 70/30 Marketing/Sales. What docs do you need?
Samir R: Hi Claire — we generally require an itemized invoice + vendor tax ID to reclaim VAT. Can you upload the receipt and the vendor name/address here?
Claire H: Uploaded photo (IMG_20240303_1521.jpg). Vendor: LocalBites Catering Ltd, printed receipt only. They said their handheld can't show VAT reg number and that they'll email an invoice later.
Ethan P: I approve the 70/30 split for tracking. Claire, please confirm which team members were at the booth (event spend policy).
Claire H: Booth staff: Claire H, Jordan L, Priya S. I asked vendor to email a proper invoice with VAT reg and line items, waiting reply.
Finance Bot: Policy reminder: expenses > $1,000 require vendor invoice with tax registration number for VAT reclaim. If vendor cannot provide, finance will reimburse but VAT becomes non-reclaimable.
Samir R: If they email a compliant invoice within 48h we can reclaim. If not, we'll reimburse the full amount and flag it as non-reclaimable VAT. Use GL codes 6401 (Marketing) / 6402 (Sales) in Concur, split 70/30.
Maya T: Marketing GL string is MARK-Q2, Sales is SALES-Q2. Ill add PO ref once Claire uploads the invoice.
Claire H: Vendor replied: "We can send an invoice but it won't include VAT ID, only name/address and total." I asked again specifically for VAT reg number.
Samir R: Forward that reply into Concur along with the receipt. We'll try an escalation to vendor ops for a tax ID. If vendor refuses, timeframe for reimbursement is 5-7 business days after manager approval.
Ethan P: Approved. Please proceed with escalation, Samir. :thumbsup:
Claire H: Uploaded vendor reply + receipt to Concur and marked split 70/30. Id appreciate vendor ops escalation.
Samir R: Got it. I'll ping vendor-ops and our procurement contact. Will update thread with outcome.
Claire H: Thanks, filing this as expense now and will ping if vendor sends VAT ID.
